_note: Draft card hooks for the accepted upstairs painting. Not merged into content/v2/boulangerie/hooks.json until the downstairs stair is installed. They describe what is painted. They do not invent a sound cue.

fr_boucherie_noun.hook: "boo-shuh-REE": the wall sign reads BOUCHERIE, the butcher's shop.
fr_boucherie_noun.why: The sign is painted. The English word butchery is the cognate, not a second object.

fr_crevette_noun.why: Plain depiction. No car is painted, so the Corvette sound cue is not claimed.

fr_huitre_noun.hook: "WEETR": one oyster with a pearl on the lower shelf.
fr_huitre_noun.why: Plain depiction. No painted sign says we treat.

fr_ecaille_noun.hook: "ay-KAHY": a paper kite beside one scaled fish and one shell.
fr_ecaille_noun.why: The kite is the sound cue and it is painted, with the scales and the shell. The tortoise in the source hook is not in this picture.

fr_abattoir_noun.hook: "ah-bah-TWAHR": a blank plaque. The slaughterhouse is not drawn.
fr_abattoir_noun.why: Sensitive word stays a blank plaque. No picture and no letters on it.

fr_steak_noun.hook: "STEHK": one grilled steak on a plate.
fr_steak_noun.why: Plain depiction. Nobody in the picture is saying the vowel.

fr_charcutier_noun.hook: "shahr-kew-TYAY": the clerk slices a ham at his own table. No blood.
fr_charcutier_noun.why: The ham is red and cured. The knife is on the ham. The picture does not show pale cooked slices.

fr_requin_noun.hook: "ruh-KAN": one whole shark on ice, mouth shut. Plain depiction.
fr_requin_noun.why: The source sound cue, a shark chewing a wreck and a can, is not painted. No replacement pun was invented.

fr_mangeur_noun.hook: "mahn-ZHUHR": an adult eats bread at his own table.
fr_mangeur_noun.why: Plain depiction. No manger trough is painted.
